pages.title: Acme Analytics - demand forecasting for retailers
pages.text: Acme Analytics helps mid-size retailers forecast demand. Connect Shopify, NetSuite or your POS, and get store-level forecasts every morning. Trusted by 300 retail brands in the US, UK and Canada. Start a 14-day free trial - plans from $49 per month.

pages.title: Bright Smile Dental - family dentist in Austin, TX
pages.text: Bright Smile Dental is a family-owned dental practice in South Austin. Dr. Lee and our team offer cleanings, fillings, Invisalign and same-day crowns. New patients welcome - call or book online.
